propositions: Five per-extra matrix cells plus a union cell consume 21 concurrent job slots while GitHub Free org limit is 20, causing queue delays of 6.7-8.4 minutes for macOS slots and extending run time from ~21m to 41-47m
The current matrix list ({agents, eval, tracing, mcp, grounding}) differs from _optional.EXTRAS ({agents, eval, grounding, metrics, tracing}), causing metrics to have no per-extra CI validation today
